00069 void LeakDCUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00070 {
00071   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00072   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00073   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00074   float* b1Samples = inputs[Coeff].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00075   float newb1 = *b1Samples;
00076   
00077   if(newb1 != b1)
00078   {
00079 //    float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor();
00080     float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00081     
00082     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00083     {
00084       float x0 = *inputSamples++; 
00085       *outputSamples++ = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00086       x1 = x0;
00087       b1 += b1_slope;     
00088     }
00089     
00090     b1 = newb1;
00091   }
00092   else
00093   {
00094     while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00095     {
00096       float x0 = *inputSamples++; 
00097       *outputSamples++ = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00098       x1 = x0;
00099     }
00100   }
00101   
00102   y1 = zap(y1); // denormal!
00103 }

00112 void LeakDCUGenInternalK::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00113 {
00114   const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();
00115   unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;
00116   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00117   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00118   float* inputSamples = inputs[Input].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00119   float* b1Samples = inputs[Coeff].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00120   float newb1 = *b1Samples;
00121   
00122   int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;
00123   
00124   if(newb1 != b1)
00125   {
00126 //    float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) * UGen::getSlopeFactor() * krBlockSize;
00127     float b1_slope = (newb1 - b1) * krBlockSize / (float)numSamplesToProcess;
00128             
00129     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00130     {
00131       if(numKrSamples == 0)     
00132       {
00133         b1 += b1_slope; 
00134         float x0 = *inputSamples; 
00135         value = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00136         x1 = x0;
00137       }
00138       
00139       numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00140       
00141       blockPosition   += numKrSamples;
00142       inputSamples    += numKrSamples;
00143       
00144       while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00145       {
00146         *outputSamples++ = value;
00147         --numSamplesToProcess;
00148         --numKrSamples;
00149       }
00150     }
00151     
00152     b1 = newb1;
00153     
00154   }
00155   else
00156   {
00157     while(numSamplesToProcess > 0)
00158     {
00159       if(numKrSamples == 0)     
00160       {
00161         float x0 = *inputSamples; 
00162         value = y1 = x0 - x1 + b1 * y1; 
00163         x1 = x0;
00164       }
00165       
00166       numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;
00167       
00168       blockPosition   += numKrSamples;
00169       inputSamples    += numKrSamples;
00170       
00171       while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples)
00172       {
00173         *outputSamples++ = value;
00174         --numSamplesToProcess;
00175         --numKrSamples;
00176       }
00177     }
00178   }
00179   
00180   y1 = zap(y1);
00181 }

00183 LeakDC::LeakDC(UGen const& input, UGen const& coeff) throw()
00184 {
00185   UGen inputs[] = { input, coeff };
00186   const int numInputChannels = findMaxInputChannels(numElementsInArray(inputs), inputs);    
00187   initInternal(numInputChannels);
00188   
00189   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)
00190   {
00191     internalUGens[i] = new LeakDCUGenInternal(input, coeff);
00192     internalUGens[i]->initValue(input.getValue(i));
00193   }
00194 }
